title: Whodunit in the Cigar Lounge
story: In a dimly lit, plush cigar lounge, the enigmatic owner, Mr. Montego, met a sudden and brutal end. As the police entered the room, they noticed a locked French door, a smashed vase, and an empty whiskey decanter. The only entry and exit were two side doors, each with a doorman on duty. All guests reported no suspicious behavior.
victim: Mr. Montego, the cigar lounge owner
crimeScene: The locked French door, smashed vase, and empty whiskey decanter
forensicClue: A peculiar scent of vanilla lingered in the air, distinct from the usual cigar smoke
question: Who committed the crime and how did they do it?
options: Option A (The Guest with the mysterious vanilla scent and reason)
Option B (The Doorman with alibi and reason)
Option C (The Cigar Company Owner and reason)
deductionExplanation: The player must examine the vanilla scent clue and consider the alibi of the doorman and motives of all suspects to solve the case.
